task_message:
Case V60: segment the vascular soft-tissue tumor on this T2-weighted MRI.

Volume: 141x141x68 voxels, 1 mm isotropic. Budgets: max 40 tool calls / 15 model prompts / 10 min wall time.
Start with `seg_open`. Finish with `seg_finish`.
final_assistant_text:
The case is complete. 

**Summary of what I did:**
1. **Located the lesion** with axial/coronal/sagittal contact sheets: a T2-hyperintense, multilobulated vascular mass in the right anterolateral thigh (superficial/fascial plane), spanning ~axial 13–50 with lobules showing bright rims and darker centres, distinct from the posterior skin fiducial and from the scattered bright superficial vessels.
2. **Seeded the mask** with positive points on the two dominant lobules (v1, 3.8 mL).
3. **Tested the medial serpiginous "tail"** with an extra point — this caused the model to propagate along a long draining vein (mask exploded to the whole thigh, 6.0 mL), so I undid it and kept the vessel excluded.
4. **Verified all ends and rims** using mask-overlay axial, sagittal and coronal sheets plus two final reviews: no lesion tissue was visible in any past-the-mask panel, and the bright lines just beyond the inferior/superior ends were confirmed to be vessels rather than tumour.
5. **Smoothed the boundary** with one refine pass (v3, 3.7 mL, single component) and saved the final review with code 2555.

Final mask: 3.7 mL, one connected component, following the tumour boundary in all three planes (medium confidence, since the tiny contiguous vascular channels at the lesion margin are borderline between tumour and draining vessel).
